name: Hanceville City Hall
summary: City Hall is the main office for city business. Call here for the City Clerk, permits, business licenses, facility rentals and general questions.

name: Mayor's Office
summary: The Mayor leads city departments, works with the council on policies and budgets, and in Hanceville also votes as a member of the City Council.

name: City Council
summary: Five council members and the Mayor set city policy, pass ordinances and approve the budget. Regular meetings are the second and fourth Thursday of each month at 6:00 PM at City Hall.

name: Permits, Business Licenses and Rentals
summary: Building permits, new construction permits, business licenses and alcohol beverage license applications are handled at City Hall. You can download the forms from the city's documents page.
how: Download the form, fill it out and bring it to City Hall, or call with questions.

name: Car Tags, Titles and Property Taxes (County Satellite Office)
summary: A satellite office of the Cullman County courthouse inside City Hall handles vehicle tags, titles, mobile home renewals and property taxes, so you don't have to drive to Cullman.
how: Renew a tag online with the website button, or stop by City Hall.

name: City Job Openings
summary: The city posts open jobs on its employment page and takes applications at City Hall. As of Oct. 30, 2026, the city lists no open positions. The City of Hanceville is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

name: City Alerts by Text, Call or Email
summary: Sign up on the city's website to get official notices about road closures, utility work, storm shelters and community events by text, phone call or email.

name: City of Hanceville on YouTube
summary: The city posts recordings of City Council meetings and public announcements on its official YouTube channel.

name: Emergency: Call 911
summary: Call 911 for any fire, medical emergency or crime in progress. It is free and answered 24 hours a day.

name: Hanceville Fire and Rescue
summary: Hanceville Fire and Rescue answers emergency calls around the clock. Call the non emergency line for burn permits, the smoke alarm installation program and general questions. For emergencies, call 911.

name: Storm Shelter: Behind the Library
summary: Holds up to 90 people. Public Works opens the city's storm shelters during a Tornado Watch.

name: Storm Shelter: C.W. Day Park
summary: Holds up to 90 people. Public Works opens the city's storm shelters during a Tornado Watch.

name: Storm Shelter: Steppville
summary: Holds up to 90 people and sits just past the railroad tracks. Public Works opens the city's storm shelters during a Tornado Watch.

name: Hanceville Water and Sewer Board
summary: The water board has served Hanceville since 1925. Call or stop by for new service, billing questions and leaks, or pay your bill online.
how: Tap Website to pay your water bill online.

name: Public Works Department
summary: Public Works repairs and maintains city streets, picks up brush and handles street light outages. Call City Hall to report a problem.

name: Cullman Electric Cooperative
summary: Cullman Electric Cooperative provides power in the Hanceville area. You can pay your bill online or at the main office in Cullman.

name: Cullman Jefferson Gas
summary: Cullman Jefferson Gas provides natural gas service in the area. Pay your bill online or visit the main office.

name: Parks and Recreation
summary: The city runs four parks along with youth sports and facility rentals. You can now reserve and pay for park facilities online through the city's Jarvis rental system.

name: C.W. Day Park
summary: The city's busiest park has ball fields, a youth football field, a walking trail, a playground and the community pool.

name: Veterans Memorial Park
summary: A quiet park with a walking trail, a fishing pond, shady benches and memorials that honor local veterans.

name: Donald Hamby Memorial Park
summary: A small green space along Highway 31 that's handy for a quick break, a picnic or a little play time.

name: Tucker Park
summary: Donated land near the fire station that the city is turning into a natural area with walking trails. More improvements are planned.

name: Shirley Burden Public Library
summary: The city library offers books, kids programs, computers and a used book shop that supports children's programs. Donations are welcome and tax deductible.
hours: Tuesday to Friday 8 AM to 5 PM (closed noon to 1 PM), Saturday 9 AM to 1 PM, closed Monday

name: Hanceville Civic Center
summary: The city's civic center has meeting rooms, a serving kitchen and an auditorium for large events. The Planning Commission meets here. Call City Hall for rental rates and open dates.

name: Planning Commission
summary: The Planning Commission guides growth in Hanceville. It handles zoning, land subdivision and the city's master plan, and it reviews development plans. It meets the fourth Monday of each month at 6:00 PM at the Civic Center, and the public is welcome.
how: To get on the agenda, contact the Mayor's Office.

name: Events and Community Development Committee
summary: This committee advises the Mayor and council on community events, tourism and local partnerships. It meets the first Monday of each month at 6:00 PM at the Shirley Burden Public Library, and anyone may attend.

name: Zoning Map and Zoning Ordinance
summary: See how land in the city is zoned and read the zoning rules before you build, add on or open a business.

name: City Ordinances, Resolutions and Budget
summary: Read the city's ordinances, council resolutions, yearly budgets and transportation plan on the city's documents page. Large files may take a moment to open.
